summary: Retrieval-side quality filter (env-gated): drop/strip corpus apparatus at query time + measure the precision lift on a clean pool. The bridge that un-confounds tuning while the corpus is repaired upstream (todo:b80d8d7d); also a permanent safety net. Stacks on the eval-precision harness from #83.

resolution.note: Quality filter built (9e31302a), tested (35c5da28, 5 tests), and measured (e9fdc338). Outcome: modest precision lift (0.20->0.24) + a permanent default-off safety net, but NOT the unlock — and it settled tune-vs-repair: neither query-time tuning nor filtering moves the ceiling; the fix is upstream re-embed on clean text (b80d8d7d, sharpened). Knobs/filter ship dormant.
